Kit summary

Radiant SlashBasic
Deals 2 stages of 180% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to a single enemy, then steals 20% of the target's ATK (caps at 100% of Tatron's initial ATK, each target can be stolen once) and Tatron gains 100% of the stolen attribute for 2 turns.
Radiant BounceActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants [ATK Up II] to all allies for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 190% ATK [Bleed] DMG to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict 2 layers of [Bleed] on all enemies for 2 turns. Then removes 1 layer of buffs from each enemy.
Glowing Blades Lv.2After Radiant Bounce is cast, Tatron acts for 1 extra turn. After Radiant Whirl deals DMG, additionally triggers [Bleed] effect once, up to 6 layers can be triggered.
Light's ArrivalPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Immune to Turn Meter Reduction effect. If Tatron deals DMG when launching basic attacks or casting active skills, he will record 60% of the DMG value and deduct HP by the same amount of the recorded value from the target at the end of the basic attack and active skill, and clear the recorded value afterward.
Glowing Blades Lv.1At the beginning of Tatron's turns, he cleanses all control effects from self and gains [Stealth] for 1 turn. Tatron increases self Effect Hit by 50% of self initial Mastery, caps at 100% Effect Hit. Increases Tatron's DMG dealt to Boss to 300% of the original.
Glowing Blades Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, for every 1 ally with the [HP Deduction] tag deployed, permanently reduces all enemies' SPD by 40 and increases Tatron's Turn Meter by 6%. If 5 allies with the [HP Deduction] tag are deployed, DMG dealt by Tatron will ignore [DMG Immunity], and all allies' (excluding self) Turn Meters will be increased by 15%. When an ally inflicts [Bleed], Tatron gains 1 layer of [Radiance] (increases [Bleed] DMG by 3%), up to 40 layers. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times in any turn.
Radiant WhirlActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants all allies [Resolute II] for 2 turns. Afterward, deals 4 stages of 90% ATK [Bleed] DMG each to all enemies and each stage has a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. The 4th stage has a 100% chance to inflict [Heavy Bleed II] on all enemies for 2 turns.
Glowing Blades Lv.2After Radiant Bounce is cast, Tatron acts for 1 extra turn. After Radiant Whirl deals DMG, additionally triggers [Bleed] effect once, up to 6 layers can be triggered.
Source: game files.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.

At max level
Uplifting Drums
Uplifting Drums
Main statEffect Hit

Increases all allies' ATK by 7% when a battle starts.

If an ally is inflicted with Block Removal, the ally will gain 1 layer of Energizing Notes at the end of the following 3 turns, up to 1 layer can be gained at the end of each turn. Each layer of Energizing Notes increases ATK by 1.4%, up to 40 layers. This effect will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.

Additionally, when an ally is inflicted with Block Removal in their first 3 turns each wave, there is a 100% chance to gain 1 extra layer. This chance is not affected by Effect Hit or Effect RES.

If the same Echo is equipped by multiple allies at the same time in a battle, only one of them will take effect.
